mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, actor_id, article_id, comment_id, content_preview, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{actorId}, #{articleId}, #{commentId}, #{contentPreview}, #{readFlag}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
